subject.title: feat: add Podman agent sandbox backend

question: Should OpenClaw accept this Podman sandbox backend as a bundled official plugin with the proposed public SDK helper exports, or should the work move to an external plugin/narrower SDK path first?
rationale: The patch is plausible, but accepting it changes official sandbox/security posture, plugin SDK API surface, generated docs, and dependency graph ownership, which automation cannot choose for maintainers.

options.title: Review as bundled backend
options.body: Sponsor the PR as the official Podman backend, then require security/dependency approval, a rebase, and focused upgrade/runtime proof before merge.

options.title: Narrow the SDK first
options.body: Ask for a smaller public sandbox SDK seam or internal ownership refactor before deciding whether Podman should be bundled.

options.title: Move to external plugin
options.body: Ask the contributor to publish a ClawHub/npm plugin using existing seams unless maintainers identify a missing core API.

recommendation.title: Review as bundled backend
recommendation.body: Sponsor the PR as the official Podman backend, then require security/dependency approval, a rebase, and focused upgrade/runtime proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: Current sandbox registry, Docker backend, SDK sandbox barrel, and OpenShell plugin pattern all trace to this recent area history.
